title: Searching for a Zscaler Client Connector App Profile

blocks.text: You can quickly find a specific Zscaler Client Connector App Profile using the Search field by selecting different criteria to narrow down your search results.
To find a Zscaler Client Connector Profile using the Search field:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Select OS.
On the App Profiles tab, you can select a search option from the drop-down menu.
Select the Search field. You can search using the following criteria:
Enter search words and press Enter to display your search results.

blocks.text: To clear the Search field, delete the search term you typed and press Enter.
